design.fixture_independence: Fixture IDs, function names, and source layouts differ from the frozen eight failure fixtures. Acceptance is defined by generic fact cardinality, structural ownership, exact source-slice spans, and composability relations; no frozen failure ID or expected v0.1 status is a runtime input.
design.no_go_cases_reason: No Go frontend mechanism was adjudicated among the frozen eight failures. Expanding Go remediation here would exceed the four-mechanism scope; unchanged Go behavior remains protected by the later all-48 regression gate.

expectation_semantics.unique_slice_rule: Every source_slice named below must occur exactly once in its case. Primary and independent checkers derive expected line/column spans independently from the frozen source bytes.
expectation_semantics.calls: expected_calls are exact CALL facts by callee, structurally containing scope, and source_slice. forbidden_call_slices have zero CALL facts.
expectation_semantics.compares: expected_compares are exact COMPARE facts by operator, operands, scope, and source_slice. compare_count is exact and includes no duplicate IF emission.
expectation_semantics.returns: expected_return_slices are exact complete RETURN structural spans, including a terminal semicolon when one is present.
expectation_semantics.representation: representation_owner_relation=EQUAL requires the returned object representation owner and the RETURN fact to have identical structural spans. representation_owner_count=0 is a negative control.
expectation_semantics.python_calls: Python CALL counts are exact per scope. AST-derived nested calls under a returned expression must each be emitted exactly once.
expectation_semantics.assignments: expected_assignments are exact semantic assignment relations by lhs and required rhs labels.
